name: pdf-edit
description: PDF Edit: shortcuts for the Rust (cargo) build. Nothing to install with pnpm.

scripts.web:deploy: cd site && test -s netlify/lib/release.generated.mts && test -s dist/index.html || { echo 'Nothing to deploy: run scripts/build-web.sh --ui-rev HEAD --dmg dist/PDF-Edit-<version>.dmg first' >&2; exit 1; }; if grep -q "sha256: '0\{64\}'" netlify/lib/release.generated.mts; then echo 'site/dist is a preview build (no --dmg): rebuild with --dmg before deploying to production' >&2; exit 1; fi; netlify deploy --prod --dir dist --functions netlify/functions
